summary: Plan v5 (24 phases, superseding the v2 handoff below whose phase numbers do NOT map onto v5). Phases 0-6 landed sorry-free and CI-green, each committed incrementally: the Phase 0 kill test (tag closure under the neg encoding), the witness-reuse rule modalApplyOneS5w + free bridges (Phase 1), the Hintikka congruence bridge hintikka_congr (Phase 2), the R7 fuel-domination refutation as decide-backed theorems plus three corrected docstrings (Phase 3), the linear budget arithmetic modalOps/mintTags (Phase 4), the generalized accTargetsKnown top-loop propagation (Phase 5), and the tag invariant S5wTagInv/usedTags plus mint-tag lemmas (Phase 6). Phase 7 (the counting crux -- the load-bearing new proof binding modalMaxWorld to usedTags.card) was analyzed but not attempted: see blockers for a documented signature-completeness finding that should inform the next dispatch. Zero sorry, zero new axioms across all landed work; full project lake build green (3239/3239) as of the Phase 6 commit.

blockers.open_goal: N/A -- not attempted this dispatch; analysis only, no Lean written for this phase
blockers.why: Phase 7's stated theorem signature `modalStepBranchS5w_preserves_worldInv (hT : S5wTagInv φ₀ b) (hW : S5wWorldInv φ₀ b) (h : modalStepBranchGen modalApplyOneS5w b e acc = some (bs, es, acc')) : ∀ b' ∈ bs, S5wTagInv φ₀ b' ∧ S5wWorldInv φ₀ b'` appears UNDER-HYPOTHESIZED. The mint/non-mint case split works cleanly for the two mint shapes (T(diamond phi)@w / F(box phi)@w): the reuse sub-case adds no new world (edge targets an EXISTING known world) and the genuine-mint sub-case grows modalMaxWorld by exactly 1 while usedTags strictly grows (via modalApplyOneS5w_outputs_tags, landed Phase 6), which is the clean part. The problem is the NON-mint shapes: K's own boxPos (T(box phi)@w -> propagate to acc.successorsOf w) and diamondNeg (F(diamond phi)@w -> propagate to acc.successorsOf w) emit formulas at labels drawn from acc.successorsOf w, and WITHOUT accTargetsKnown b acc as an ambient invariant, nothing bounds those labels by modalMaxWorld b -- so modalMaxWorld could in principle grow at a non-mint step too, breaking the S5wWorldInv <= usedTags.card chain (which only accounts for mint-shape growth). accTargetsKnown is NOT threaded through the plan's stated two-hypothesis signature.

recommended_next_dispatch: 1. Add accTargetsKnown b acc as a THIRD hypothesis (and conclusion component) to modalStepBranchS5w_preserves_worldInv -- a documented, necessary deviation from the plan's literal 2-hypothesis signature, not an optional embellishment. This is cheap to discharge: modalApplyOneS5w already satisfies the RuleApplicationSpec-style hFreshLocal dichotomy (acc unchanged, OR .linear (wsf :: rest) with acc.addEdge sf.label wsf.label) -- verify this directly (it should follow immediately from modalApplyOneS5w's definition: the reuse case emits exactly .linear [witness] with acc.addEdge sf.label witness.label, and the mint case falls through verbatim to K's own modalApplyOne, which already has this shape via modalApplyOne_fresh_local). Given that dichotomy, accTargetsKnown preservation for modalApplyOneS5w is a FREE instantiation of FmpMeasure.lean's already-generic modalStepBranch_preserves_accTargetsKnown_gen -- no new proof needed, just supply the concrete hFreshLocal witness.

2. With accTargetsKnown threaded, prove modalStepBranchS5w_preserves_worldInv by case-splitting modalStepBranchGen's single-step unfold on sf's shape: (a) the two mint shapes via modalApplyOneS5w's own match (reuse sub-case: modalMaxWorld unchanged since witnessWorldS5_mem gives w' known, hence w' <= modalMaxWorld b via a landed label_le_modalMaxWorld-style fact; usedTags monotone via usedTags_mono since b subset b'; mint sub-case: modalMaxWorld b' = modalMaxWorld b + 1 via modalNextWorld_gt-style reasoning, usedTags strictly grows via modalApplyOneS5w_outputs_tags + witnessWorldS5 = none meaning the tag was NOT already in usedTags -- needs a new lemma connecting witnessWorldS5 = none to (s,psi) not-in usedTags, likely near-trivial from the two definitions' shared use of modalKnownWorlds/b.any); (b) all other shapes via modalApplyOneS5w_eq_of_not_mint_shape (landed Phase 1) falling to modalApplyOneS5, itself either the S5 propagation arms (modalS5BoxAll_mem/modalS5DiaNegAll_mem, landed, already give x.label in modalKnownWorlds b) or K's prop rules (same-world, trivial) or K's boxPos/diamondNeg (successorsOf-bounded, NOW dischargeable via the threaded accTargetsKnown).

3. Then land modalMaxWorld_lt_worldBound_of_S5w by chaining: modalMaxWorld b <= (usedTags phi0 b).card <= (mintTags phi0).card <= modalOps phi0 < modalWorldBound phi0 (the last two steps already landed in Phase 4/6: mintTags_card_le_modalOps, modalOps_lt_worldBound; usedTags subset mintTags is immediate from usedTags' definition as a Finset.filter of mintTags).

4. If the accTargetsKnown threading resists or the case-split proves substantially larger than the phase's 2h budget, mark Phase 7 [BLOCKED] with the exact open goal per the R9 risk mitigation -- do NOT introduce a sorry or weaken S5wWorldInv's statement.

5. Phases 8 (R1 scratch gate, no .lean file edited) and 9-14 (spec split, Hintikka lift, soundness, archival) remain fully unattempted and gate the rest of the S5 chain; Phases 15-23 (the Euclidean 5/KB5 route) are independent of 0-14's internals and can proceed in parallel once Phase 14 lands, per the plan's own wave DAG.
